title: Game night this Sunday at the Social BTB on Sunday
seo_title: Game Night at Social BTB Joplin on November 15
description: Game night at Social BTB in Joplin, where you can play games from 4 pm to 9 pm, borrow games on hand or bring your own, and come with friends or mingle with others. The event is free with no purchases required, and games include Elder Sign, Balderdash, Uno, and the featured game Monikers, an easy-to-learn comedic social game. It takes place Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 1027 S Main St, Suite 102, Joplin, MO.
